notes: Tuition: the pages do not tie this programme to a fee group; the only accepted quote that names Morocco is the GROUP B (middle-income) country list, so the non-EU non-resident fee is €300 total contribution per year (first instalment €75, further instalments €75 each). The GROUP A figure shown as evidence is not Morocco's group; the amount for Morocco is €300 per year, not €600. No quote ties the programme to a degree-class group, so per the task rules the country-group fee is used for the group that names Morocco. Application deadlines: the Universitaly window 'From April 2026 to November 30, 2026' is a visa/pre-enrolment deadline and is not written as an application deadline. No day-and-year application deadline for international applicants is stated.
